candidate.subject: chemistry
candidate.question: A heated flask contains solution X. A delivery tube carries the gas from the flask into an inverted water-filled receiver, where nitrogen gas (N₂) is collected over water. Which mixture could X contain?
candidate.ai_explanation: On warming, sodium nitrite and ammonium chloride produce nitrogen: NaNO₂ + NH₄Cl → NaCl + N₂ + 2H₂O. The ammonium and nitrite ions together supply the two nitrogen atoms. Nitrogen is only slightly soluble in water, allowing collection by displacement of water. Nitrate and nitrite are different ions, NO₃⁻ and NO₂⁻ respectively.
